notes_for_editor: No build date, staffing, public access or present status found. The federal listing for DL1381 is nonpublished (no datasheet). Its two entries carry codes: one for a surface mark reported destroyed and one for no geodetic control. That refers to the survey mark, not necessarily the tower; it does not prove the tower is gone, and the status needs a site check. The 1942 description comes only from the Central US Lookouts transcription. The source spells the place THORTON; the story uses Thornton. Do not confuse this tower with the separate Bucksnort Lookout Tower 4 1 AFC in Bradley County (central site bucksnort1.html, NGS DL1311), which has no record here and is not used. The record's location (33.8249, -92.5047) agrees with the NGS approximate position (33 49 29 N, 092 30 16 W).
